pages.name: Benoni Defense: Fianchetto Variation
pages.notes: Plan 2 played ...Na6-c7 after ...a6 had taken a6; plan 3 rerouted Nf3-e1-d3 with the king on e1; plan 1 used a3 to stop ...b5. Rewrote plans 1-3; British spelling (Defence, manoeuvring, centre).

pages.name: Benoni Defense: Fianchetto Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 used a3 to stop ...b5 (a4 does); plan 2 played ...Ne8-c7 with the king on e8. Rewrote both plans; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Benoni Defense: Knight's Tour Variation
pages.notes: Overview and plan 1 sent the knight to b3 or e4 and a Ba3 to challenge the dark-squared g7-bishop; the 7.Nd2 idea is Nc4 against d6. Rewrote overview and plans 1, 2 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni Defense: Uhlmann Variation
pages.notes: Plan 2 played ...g5 with the bishop still on g5; plan 1 had an unsupported Bxf6 and h2-h4 attack. Rewrote plans 1-2; British spelling in the overview and plan 3.

pages.name: Benoni: 6.Nf3 g6 7.Bf4 Bg7
pages.notes: Plan 3 had ...Nbd7-b8-a6 (nonsense); plan 4 traded the g7-bishop via Bh2, which cannot reach it. Rewrote plans 1, 3 and 4.

pages.name: Benoni: 6.Nf3 g6 7.h3
pages.notes: Plan 2 castled before the bishop left f8 and played ...Na6-c7 after ...a6. Rewrote plans 1-2.

pages.name: Benoni: Uhlmann, 7...Bg7
pages.notes: Plan 1 called the g5-bishop light-squared; plan 3 developed a bishop already on g5; plan 4 targeted a d4-pawn that is not there. Rewrote all four plans; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Benoni: Uhlmann, 7...h6
pages.notes: Overview called 7.Bg5 a fianchetto setup; plan 1 pushed ...g5 with the bishop on g5. Rewrote the overview phrase and plan 1; plan 2 wording.

pages.name: Benoni: Fianchetto, 9.O-O
pages.notes: Plan 1 rerouted Nd2-f1-e3 with a rook on f1. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Benoni: Fianchetto, 9.O-O Re8
pages.notes: Overview and plan 2 prepared a ...e5 break with no Black e-pawn; plan 2 knight route via f8 replaced. Rewrote overview phrase and both plans; British spelling.
